name: n8n-nodes-plentyone
description: n8n community node for the PlentyONE (formerly plentymarkets) REST API

scripts.copy-assets: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; mkdir -p dist/nodes/Plentymarkets/operations dist/credentials; cp nodes/Plentymarkets/operations/*.json dist/nodes/Plentymarkets/operations/; cp nodes/Plentymarkets/plentyone.svg dist/nodes/Plentymarkets/; cp nodes/Plentymarkets/plentyone.svg dist/credentials/'
